goal_title: Build the biome engine — make the world evolve across sequences
why: soft_stages.json declares what each sequence's biome should do. grammar_operations.json declares what operations are available. BiomeRingComponent spawns creatures. But the three systems aren't wired into a single coherent engine. Once wired, walking from primitives to QFEP produces visible, legible world evolution — density 0.0 → 1.0, kingdoms unlocking, operations composing.
success_criteria: BiomeRing reads current sequence and applies soft_stages rules automatically
Grammar operations registered per sequence gate what the biome can generate
Player sees visible biome change when crossing sequence boundaries
Sequence progression produces measurable visual difference: density, kingdoms, sky color, particles

tasks.title: Audit current biome wiring across all maps
tasks.spec: Grep for BiomeRingComponent, NatureRenderer, and soft_stages usage across commons/maps/. Which maps have it active? Which sequence-specific settings actually apply? Output: doc/tasks/_audits/biome_wiring_audit.md.

tasks.title: Make biome auto-load sequence stage
tasks.spec: BiomeRingComponent should read the current map's sequence (via metadata or lookup) and apply the matching entry from commons/maps/soft_stages.json without needing per-map config. If this already works, document how; if not, wire it up.

tasks.title: Wire grammar_operations.json into biome spawning
tasks.spec: The biome's kingdom spawning should filter by unlocked grammar operations. If an L-system operation hasn't been unlocked yet (player is in sequence 1–5), branch/tree generation shouldn't fire even if the biome supports it. Document the gating mechanism.

tasks.title: Capture biome at each sequence for docs
tasks.spec: Use capture pipeline to screenshot the biome in the first map of each of the 19 sequences. Save to ada_encyclopedia/public/biome_evolution/<seq_id>.png. Shows the world-evolution progression as image sequence.
